'''Fortmaker''' is a 5★ [[Sword]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|One of the weapons made by Fort Forgefane. The sword features traditional architecture that made it extremely durable and sturdy. The thick, heavy blade left countless scars upon the permafrost as the frontlines shifted with the times.}}

==Basic Info==

WE WERE HEADING TOWARDS THE BLASTED SOUTH! Nobody knew we were going south until we started down the road!"<br>Jerreth toyed with the pen in his hand. Without ink, it was little more than an empty tube.<br>"I ... I don't know what to write... How should I report this? Gah... I should get the hell out of this place."<br>The supplies on the trailer truck were completely destroyed. They'll murder my career for robbing the glory of this magnificent battle!"<br>Jerreth buried his face in his hands and howled in agony. There is no such thing as a silent and ignominious death."<br><br>"I'm going home."<br>He mumbled to himself as he cast everything aside. He threw away his memories, career, and responsibilities at this very site right next to the suit of heavy armor.<br>"I'm going home..."<br>And thus he left a trail of footprints as he trudged towards a certain direction.
